decision.rationale: Corrected the mocked flag key from the nonexistent 'features:localAnalytics' to the production 'features:cliAnalytics', and changed the mock catch-all from [false, true] to [true, true] so the corrected branch determines the assertion instead of being shadowed by the default. Safe because AnalyticsPage reads exactly three flags, all handled explicitly in the mock.
React key changed from the bare dispatch.label to a composite of label and index, so two dispatches sharing a label can no longer collide.

Added 'if (clicked && !clicked.user_id) return' ahead of handleDrill so a row that cannot be drilled into is not highlighted. Guarding on clicked preserves deselection, since clicked is undefined when the click removes an already-selected row. Reachability was confirmed against the backend rather than assumed: user_id is declared 'str | None' and the router assigns None whenever identity resolution fails or the email does not resolve to a UUID.
